question: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maan Dhan Yojana is a government scheme meant for old age protection and social security of Small and Marginal Farmers (SMF). It provides for an assured Pension of _________ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹3,000 month**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• The Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maan Dhan Yojana is a pension scheme for Small and Marginal Farmers (SMF) in India, ensuring old age protection and social security.

• The scheme provides for an assured monthly pension of ₹3,000 upon attaining the age of 60 years.

• Farmers aged between 18 and 40 years are eligible to join the scheme, contributing to the pension fund till they reach 60 years.

• The contributions are shared equally between the farmer and the government of India, with the Life Insurance Corporation (LIC) managing the pension fund.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)**

• It is a central sector scheme launched in December 2018 to provide financial assistance to farmers.

• Under this scheme, an income support of ₹6,000 per year is provided to all farmer families in three equal installments of ₹2,000 each.

• The amount is directly transferred to the bank accounts of the beneficiaries.

• This scheme aims to ensure a life of dignity for the farmers by providing them with financial support.

• **Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)**

• Launched on 13 January 2016, it is an insurance service for farmers for their yields.

• The aim is to reduce the premium burden on farmers and ensure early settlement of crop insurance claims.

• Farmers pay a uniform premium of 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, and 5% for commercial/horticultural crops.

• The remaining premium is paid by the government to provide full insured amounts to farmers against crop loss.

• **Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchai Yojana (PMKSY)**

• Launched on 1 July 2015, it aims to enhance irrigation sources to achieve more crop per drop.

• It focuses on creating protective irrigation by ensuring the completion of various water resources projects.

• The scheme includes both major and minor irrigation projects and promotes efficient water usage practices.

• It also supports the creation of new water sources through rainwater harvesting, watershed development, and micro-irrigation.
